gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
I had to turn ___ their invitation because I was ill.
gaps.explanation: turn down = reject an offer/invitation; turn up = appear.

gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: Small suppliers are struggling to keep their heads ___ water.
gaps.explanation: 'Keep your head above water' = just manage to survive, especially financially.

gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
Can we narrow the list ___ to three names?
gaps.explanation: narrow down = reduce the number of possibilities.

gaps.sentence: A new proposal was put ___ at the meeting.
gaps.explanation: put forward = propose, suggest (an idea, plan, name).
